verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce is payment infrastructure that serves third-party AI agents through APIs, an MCP server, an agent toolkit and the Trusted Agent Protocol. Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in AI assistant inside the product that users can delegate tasks to. The toolkit's "work with AI agents using plain language" claim refers to the user's own external agents connecting via MCP, which is adjacent support rather than a native assistant, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
